Pioneer tokens · Deseret Assay Office Restrikes “1860” Later-period Mormon Lion/Beehive $5 gold half eagles were struck in 1860. The original coins had a smooth edge and coin-flip orientation. Commissioned by Utah-based collectibles dealer. Production Data. These restrikes (in 2024-2025) have a reeded-edge and medal-turn orientation. All gold pieces were over-struck on vintage US Mint Liberty-Head gold coins (unless otherwise noted). Produced using tribute dies, based on photos of original coins. NOTE: Minted on commission for distributor.

Pioneer tokens · Mormon Pioneer Restrikes “1850” Early-period Mormon $5 gold half eagles were struck in 1849 and 1850. The original coins had a smooth edge and coin-flip orientation. Commissioned by Utah-based collectibles dealer. Production Data. These restrikes (in 2025) have a reeded-edge and coin-flip orientation (unless otherwise noted). All gold pieces were over-struck on vintage US Mint Liberty-Head gold coins (unless otherwise noted). Produced using tribute dies, based on photos of original coins. NOTE: Minted on commission for distributor.
